type.quote: The Arkansas State Board of Nursing shall have the following powers and responsibilities

umbrella_agency.quote: Make an annual report to the Secretary of the Department of Health

degree_required.value: Approved professional nursing education program (varies by license type)

exams.name: NCLEX-RN
exams.quote: The applicant shall be required to pass an examination in such subjects as the board may determine. Upon successfully passing the examination, the board shall issue to the applicant a license to practice professional nursing as a registered nurse

exams.name: NCLEX-PN
exams.quote: The applicant shall be required to pass an examination in such subjects as the board may determine. Upon successful completion of the examination, the board shall issue to the applicant a license to practice as a licensed practical nurse

exams.name: National certification exam (APRN)
exams.notes: National certification by a board-recognized certifying body required for APRN licensure
exams.quote: national certification approved by the board under one (1) of the following roles of an advanced practice registered nurse

exams.name: Written examination (psychiatric technician nurse)
exams.notes: May be supplemented by oral examination
exams.quote: The applicant shall be required to pass a written examination in such subjects as the board may determine. Each written examination may be supplemented by an oral examination.

interval_years.quote: The Arkansas State Board of Nursing shall prescribe the procedure for the cyclical biennial renewal of licenses to every person licensed by the board.

required.quote: The Arkansas State Board of Nursing shall adopt rules setting minimum standards for continuing education to ensure that all licensed nurses remain informed about those technical and professional subjects which the board deems appropriate to nursing practice.

hours_per_period.quote: The board shall not require more than twenty (20) hours of continuing education per year.

period_years.quote: The board shall not require more than twenty (20) hours of continuing education per year.

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice professional nursing as a registered nurse by endorsement to an applicant who has been duly licensed as a registered nurse under the laws of another state, territory, or foreign country

requirements.value: Applicant must meet qualifications required of nurses in Arkansas at time of graduation; board must recommend endorsement
requirements.quote: if, in the opinion of the board, the applicant meets the qualifications required of registered nurses in this state at the time of graduation and if the board so recommends

title_protection.quote: To use any sign, card, or device to indicate that the person is a professional registered nurse, an advanced practice registered nurse, a registered nurse practitioner, a licensed practical nurse, or a licensed psychiatric technician nurse.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of a crime or gross immorality

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is habitually intemperate or is addicted to the use of habit-forming drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: License, privilege to practice, certificate, or registration revoked, suspended, placed on probation, or under disciplinary order in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license, privilege to practice, certificate, or registration revoked or suspended or has been placed on probation or under disciplinary order in any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Voluntarily surrendered a license, privilege to practice, certification, or registration and has not been reinstated in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has voluntarily surrendered a license, privilege to practice, certification, or registration and has not been reinstated in any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violated any provisions of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has willfully or repeatedly violated any of the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of or pleads guilty or nolo contendere to any offense listed in § 17-3-102, unless waiver granted
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board shall refuse to issue or shall revoke the license of any person who is found guilty of or pleads guilty or nolo contendere to any offense listed in § 17-3-102, unless the person requests and the board grants a waiver pursuant to § 17-3-102.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of professional nursing" means the performance by a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse for compensation of any acts involving: (A) The observation, care, and counsel of the ill, injured, or infirm; (B) The maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others; (C) The supervision and teaching of other personnel; (D) The delegation of certain nursing practices to other personnel as set forth in rules established by the board; or (E) The administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by practitioners authorized to prescribe and treat in accordance with state law when such acts require substantial specialized judgment and skill based on knowledge and application of the principles of biological, physical, and social sciences
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the performance by a registered nurse or an advanced practice registered nurse for compensation of any acts involving: (A) The observation, care, and counsel of the ill, injured, or infirm; (B) The maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others; (C) The supervision and teaching of other personnel; (D) The delegation of certain nursing practices to other personnel as set forth in rules established by the board; or (E) The administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by practitioners authorized to prescribe and treat in accordance with state law when such acts require substantial specialized judgment and skill

drug_authority.value: APRNs with certificate of prescriptive authority may prescribe Schedules III-V; Schedule II opioids limited to 5-day supply; Schedule II stimulants under specific conditions; CRNAs may administer Schedule II drugs during perioperative/peri-obstetrical/medical procedure period
drug_authority.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse's prescriptive authority shall extend only to drugs listed in Schedules III - V and, if expressly authorized by the collaborative practice agreement, also to those hydrocodone combination products reclassified from Schedule III to Schedule II as of October 6, 2014.

license_tiers.quote: a person practicing or offering to practice nursing for compensation shall be required to submit evidence that he or she is qualified to so practice and shall be licensed as provided in this chapter: (1) Professional nursing; (2) Advanced practice registered nursing; (3) Registered practitioner nursing; (4) Practical nursing; or (5) Psychiatric technician nursing.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Practice of advanced practice registered nursing" includes the practice of nursing as a: (i) Certified nurse practitioner; (ii) Certified registered nurse anesthetist; (iii) Certified nurse midwife; and (iv) Clinical nurse specialist

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Practice of licensed practical nursing" means the performance for compensation of nursing practices by a licensed practical nurse that are relevant to the care of the ill, injured, or infirm, or the delegation of certain nursing practices to other personnel as set forth in rules established by the board, under the direction of a registered nurse, an advanced practice registered nurse, a licensed physician, or a licensed dentist

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: Has a collaborative practice agreement with a practicing physician who is licensed under the Arkansas Medical Practices Act

full_independent_practice_available.quote: "full independent practice authority" means the ability of a certified nurse practitioner or a clinical nurse specialist to practice with prescriptive authority without a collaborative practice agreement

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: Proof of successful completion of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) hours of practice

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The Arkansas State Board of Nursing may grant a certificate of prescriptive authority to an advanced practice registered nurse

value: Schedule II (CRNAs during perioperative/peri-obstetrical/medical procedure period)
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse's prescriptive authority shall extend only to drugs listed in Schedules III - V and, if expressly authorized by the collaborative practice agreement, also to those hydrocodone combination products reclassified from Schedule III to Schedule II as of October 6, 2014.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Schedule II opioid prescriptions limited to a five-day period or less
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: The prescription is for an opioid and the prescription is only for a five-day period or less

dea_registration_required.quote: Four (4) members shall be advanced practice registered nurses at least three (3) of whom hold certificates of prescriptive authority and an active United States Drug Enforcement Administration number

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: Is currently listed in good standing on the state's certified nurse aide registry

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Medication assistive person" means a person who is certified by the board to administer certain nonprescription and legend drugs in designated facilities

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: The delegation of certain nursing practices to other personnel as set forth in rules established by the board

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Interstate Nurse Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into by this state with all states legally joining therein

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The Arkansas State Board of Nursing shall create an alternative to discipline program which shall: (1) Serve as a diversion program to which the board may refer participants when appropriate in lieu of or in addition to other disciplinary action; and (2) Be a source of referral for participants who, on a strictly voluntary basis, desire to avail themselves of its services.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: Proof of successful completion of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) hours of practice: (i) Under a board-required agreement with a physician

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: "Practice of certified registered nurse anesthesia" means the performance for compensation of advanced nursing practices by a certified registered nurse anesthetist that are relevant to the administration of anesthetics in consultation with, but not necessarily in the presence of, a licensed physician, licensed dentist, or other person lawfully entitled to order anesthesia.

cnm_out_of_hospital_birth_authorized.quote: For a delivery outside of an accredited facility, the certified nurse midwife shall identify a licensed physician or facility, or both, with which an arrangement has been made for referral and consultation in the event of a medical complication.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: Methods of management of the collaborative practice, which shall include protocols for prescriptive authority
